lastCompletedStory.title: Wire the shipping phase into the sidecar loop and make the CLEAN trigger deterministic

openQuestions: src/commands/ship.ts (runShip, the cam ship CLI thin-proxy) is UNCHANGED by this story: it still sends '/cam-ship' via tmux send-keys to the orchestrator pane (see ship.ts lines ~3-12, 110-186). US-005 must convert it to a phase-signal writer: write phase:shipping to .claude/cam-loop.local.md (mirroring runPlan's buildPlanningBody + writeStateFile pattern from plan.ts), preserving the liveness/bootstrap preamble and the paneCountMutex busy-refusal, and no longer send-keys '/cam-ship'. The --bump/--finalize in-process flags (parseShipArgs/dispatchShip in index.ts) are UNCHANGED in behavior and must stay that way per US-005 AC2 -- they already route through the new shared src/commands/ship-deps.ts factories (buildShipBumpOpts/buildShipFinalizeOpts) added in this story, but that is transparent to ship.ts/index.ts's argv parsing.

The deterministic ship runner (runShipPhase + runShipPrStep + the new sidecar shipping-phase wiring) is now fully live for BOTH triggers into phase:shipping: the auto-mode autoShipFn (this story) and, once US-005 lands, the manual `cam ship` CLI. Until US-005 ships, `cam ship` (no flags) still uses the OLD send-keys '/cam-ship' path (which dispatches the now-thinned cam-ship.md prompt, US-006's job) -- so the deterministic runner is reachable in auto mode only until US-005 completes.

makeProductionShipPhaseFn (sidecar.ts) reads scripts/cam/prd.json directly via JSON.parse(readFileSync(...)) with no try/catch of its own; a missing/malformed prd.json propagates up to the outer try/catch in the same closure, which logs a 'sidecar-exit' event (reason: 'ship-phase-crash') and resets phase to idle in the finally block. This is intentional (mirrors makeProductionPlanPhaseFn's outer safety net) but means a ship dispatched with no prd.json present produces a crash-shaped event rather than a clean ShipPhaseResult kind; worth a source-text oracle if a future story wants a dedicated 'prd-missing' result kind instead.
nextStoryContext: US-005 (convert the cam ship CLI to a phase-signal writer) consumes the now-complete deterministic ship pipeline (runShipPhase/runShipPrStep/sidecar shipping-phase wiring, all shipped in US-002/US-003/US-004) as a black box: it only needs to change HOW the shipping phase gets triggered from the CLI. Concretely: rewrite runShip (src/commands/ship.ts) to write phase:shipping to .claude/cam-loop.local.md instead of sending '/cam-ship' via send-keys, following plan.ts's runPlan precedent (liveness/bootstrap preamble -> mutex check -> writeStateFile with force:true, replacing only the final SEND step). Keep all existing injectable seams (tmuxSpawnFn, bootstrapFn, statFn, sleepFn, writeFn) and the mutex busy-refusal (shipping must not start while a worker/review pane is active). Update index.ts's cam-ship help text to mention 'writes phase:shipping; the sidecar runs the deterministic ship runner'. test/ship.test.ts needs a rewrite to assert the state-file write instead of send-keys (mirrors test/plan.test.ts's US-004/CAM-151 rewrite, per patterns.md). Never add a --permission-mode flag (test/no-permission-mode-flag.test.ts guards this globally). --bump/--finalize argv parsing and dispatch (parseShipArgs/dispatchShip) must NOT change in this story.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-004 is pure internal wiring: a new phase:'shipping' branch in the existing runSidecarLoop state machine (loop.ts) and a production dependency-injection factory (sidecar.ts) composing already-implemented, already-doc-validated internal modules (runShipPhase/US-002, runShipPrStep + gh CLI calls/US-003, runShipBump, finalizeCycleClose). No new external library surface was introduced or exercised; gh/git CLI usage is unchanged from the US-002/US-003 wiring (already validated against cli.github.com/manual in this PRD's officialDocsConsulted).
